judgments.reason: The candidate is the Mendeley Data record "ECoG_HB_02" (doi:10.17632/fp4bv9gtwk.2) that this derivative dataset repackages. It is the same data deposited elsewhere.
The dataset repackages the single public participant (HB02) of Chen et al. 2024 Nature Machine Intelligence, the study paper that reports this ECoG and speech data.
judgments.paper_title: A neural speech decoding framework leveraging deep learning and speech synthesis

judgments.reason: Zenodo release of the flinkerlab/neural_speech_decoding code repository, a software tool for the Chen et al. 2024 decoding pipeline, not a deposit of this ECoG feature data.
